Let \(m_k=\int_0^1 x^k\,d\xi(x)\). Then
\[
M(\xi)=(m_{i+j})_{0\le i,j\le 4}
\]
is the order \(4\) Hankel moment matrix, with \(m_0=1\) and \(m_1=\frac13\).

Use canonical moments \(p_k\in[0,1]\) for measures on \([0,1]\). Since \(m_1=p_1\), the constraint gives
\[
p_1=\frac13.
\]
For the Hankel determinant one has the factorization
\[
\det(m_{i+j})_{0\le i,j\le n}
=
\prod_{r=1}^n(\zeta_{2r-1}\zeta_{2r})^{n+1-r},
\]
where
\[
\zeta_1=p_1,\qquad \zeta_k=(1-p_{k-1})p_k\quad(k\ge2).
\]
This follows inductively from the Schur-complement formula for Hankel determinants: the quotient \(H_n/H_{n-1}\) is the squared \(L^2(\xi)\)-norm of the monic orthogonal polynomial of degree \(n\), and for \([0,1]\) these norms equal \(\prod_{j=1}^{2n}\zeta_j\).

For \(n=4\),
\[
\det M
=(\zeta_1\zeta_2)^4(\zeta_3\zeta_4)^3(\zeta_5\zeta_6)^2(\zeta_7\zeta_8).
\]
Substituting \(p_1=\frac13\),
\[
\det M
=
\left(\frac13\cdot\frac23 p_2\right)^4
\left((1-p_2)p_3(1-p_3)p_4\right)^3
\left((1-p_4)p_5(1-p_5)p_6\right)^2
\left((1-p_6)p_7(1-p_7)p_8\right).
\]

Now maximize factor by factor:
\[
p_2^4(1-p_2)^3 \text{ is maximized at } p_2=\frac47,
\]
\[
p_3(1-p_3)\text{ at }p_3=\frac12,
\]
\[
p_4^3(1-p_4)^2\text{ at }p_4=\frac35,
\]
\[
p_5(1-p_5)\text{ at }p_5=\frac12,
\]
\[
p_6^2(1-p_6)\text{ at }p_6=\frac23,
\]
\[
p_7(1-p_7)\text{ at }p_7=\frac12,
\]
and \(p_8\) is maximized at \(p_8=1\). These canonical moments are admissible, so the maximum is attained.

Thus
\[
\zeta_1\zeta_2=\frac13\cdot\frac23\cdot\frac47=\frac8{63},
\]
\[
\zeta_3\zeta_4=\frac37\cdot\frac12\cdot\frac12\cdot\frac35=\frac9{140},
\]
\[
\zeta_5\zeta_6=\frac25\cdot\frac12\cdot\frac12\cdot\frac23=\frac1{15},
\]
\[
\zeta_7\zeta_8=\frac13\cdot\frac12\cdot\frac12\cdot1=\frac1{12}.
\]
Therefore
\[
\max_\xi \det M(\xi)
=
\left(\frac8{63}\right)^4
\left(\frac9{140}\right)^3
\left(\frac1{15}\right)^2
\left(\frac1{12}\right).
\]
Simplifying,
\[
\left(\frac8{63}\right)^4
\left(\frac9{140}\right)^3
\left(\frac1{15}\right)^2
\left(\frac1{12}\right)
=
\frac{16}{3^5 5^5 7^7}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{16}{3^5 5^5 7^7}}
\]
